resources.string: A failed or interrupted run stops the plan and turns off automatic app and boot execution. Review the log before enabling them again.
No modules. Add a provider to start.
Save or cancel your module changes before running the plan.
Shell content must be UTF-8, at most 32 KiB, and contain no NUL characters.
Some modules are missing a required condition. Nothing was executed. Fix them and run again.
No module is enabled. Enable at least one before running.
This shell module has no script content.
No SU manager selected. Choose the installed manager for this module.
The selected SU manager is not installed or was uninstalled. Select it again.
The selected SU manager no longer provides the expected late-load library. Select the manager again.
The native bootstrap libraries are missing from this build and the device is not rooted yet.
This module needs root or a running daemon. Add a daemon bootstrap module before it.
Soft reboot needs an SU manager with a late-load backend. Add an SU manager module before it.
Soft reboot needs /data/adb/ksud or /data/adb/apd, and neither is present and executable.

string-array.name: ui_modules_descriptions
string-array.item: Start the DirtyFrag root daemon control channel.
Execute saved shell content using the available privilege.
Pick an installed manager; optionally request soft reboot after late-load.
Pre-filled shell: disable KernelSU modules before loading the manager.
Pre-filled shell: apply read-only protection to partitions.
Unused: run markers are bound to the kernel boot id and are not wiped.
Pre-filled shell: run rmmod dfroot if the module is still loaded.

resources.string: Requires the daemon and must be the last enabled step. Keeps your automatic execution settings.
A manager with soft reboot must be the last enabled module. Move it to the end or disable soft reboot.
The manager KMI cannot be resolved. Select a valid KMI branch in Settings.
Soft reboot requires the daemon handshake. Add a daemon module before this manager; SU alone is insufficient.
